# Commercial margin figures — generated, for the owner

<!-- Generated by node scripts/commercial-margin-draft.mjs from tests/commercial-margin-draft.ts. No figure is edited by hand. -->

Generated at commit `14df765f39` on 2026-11-20. The figures are the repository's own model at that commit. They are not invoices, not an approved review and not a certified profit.

> **Nothing here is approved or opened.** `CURRENT_COMMERCIAL_MARGIN_REVIEW` stays `null`. No price, limit, commission, flag, tax gate, Article 9a gate or review changes. This replaces only the figures of the hand-written draft `docs/opening-readiness/commercial-margin.md` (main `3859d4a4ef`, 14 November 2026), which are stale.

## How it is computed

- **Use:** every cost line of `tests/plan-cost-registry.ts` at 100% of every right in the worst month. A yearly payment carries 12 worst months plus what one payment leaves after the plan ends, as `planUnits` in `tests/margin-alignment-table.ts` models it. The commission on sales counts as zero.
- **Receiving:** `lib/receiving-costs.ts`. The buyer's tax is added on top of the price at up to 27%. The dearer provider's fee is taken on the whole amount charged. Remittance 1.5%, refund reserve 1%, dispute reserve 1% of (amount charged + both dispute fees).
- **Tax-collection cost:** Stripe Tax is modelled as 0.5% of the amount charged inside the Stripe fee (`PROVIDER_FEES.stripe.taxBps`); the column shows that share. Stripe Tax at a fixed fee per transaction: **not modelled**. Per-sale EU VAT/OSS (IV1) or UK VAT collection costs: **not modelled** in `lib/receiving-costs.ts` or the registry, so unknown, never zero. VAT/OSS registration and filing are the LLC fixed-cost line `vat-oss-and-local-compliance`, which is null.
- **LC reading (the owner's profit, rule LC):** IRPF 15% of the pretax profit (Lei 14.754/2023, arts. 2, §1 (15%) and 5, caput and §10, III (31 December)) and IOF 0.38% of the amount remitted, taken as the pretax profit (Decreto 6.306/2007, arts. 14 and 15-B, XXV). Each is rounded up to the cent. No ISS, no US federal income tax. This is computed outside the 27.5% floor, which now lives only in `tests/historical-receiving-model.ts`. The code's `MOST_CORRECT_READING` holds the same two rates.
- **Email (LC):** Amazon SES at $0.10 per 1,000 ($0.0001 per email), swapped for the code's `PER_EMAIL` ($0.0009 per email) everywhere the registry uses it. It holds only once the 309 [EM1] protections are merged and published. The Resend Pro subscription then becomes an LLC fixed cost (`tools`, null today), never zero.
- **Room:** the spend-floor room (25¢ monthly, 100¢ yearly, 25¢ for the assistant, none for captions) is charged as a cost before tax. "Net after room" is the result of that. A unit is **positive** when it keeps at least 1¢ after room (rule MR).
- **AI** in the plan rows is held at the automatic monthly ceiling (`AUTOMATIC_AI_STORE_MICRO_USD`), as the registry's `ai` line does. The section after the tables shows every AI right at its largest request.

## Studio and Scale with every AI right used

`aiEntitlementsFunded` prices every permitted call at the largest request the code allows (`AUTOMATIC_AI_SPEND_CEILINGS.requestMicroUsd`). The automatic ceiling stops spending before that, so no loss happens today; the gate fails because the published rights are not funded. "Haiku only" assumes two code changes: Haiku as the only allowed model and the ceiling raised to fund every right. LC reading, SES email, net after room, per payment.

## Why `commercialPlansMayOpen(true)` is false today

`commercialPlansMayOpen(true)` returns **false**. Each check, read from the code:

| Check | Passes | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Owner's request (OPENING_REQUESTED, lib/opening.ts) | not read | Private to lib/opening.ts and not read here. This list asks commercialPlansMayOpen(true), as lib/opening-readiness.ts does, so the request is not counted as a reason. |
| CURRENT_COMMERCIAL_MARGIN_REVIEW recorded and readable | **no** | It is null. commercialPlansMayOpen returns false at this step; every check below is what a review would still meet. |
| Commission: none published, or live and proved | yes | COMMISSION_PLANS_PUBLISHED=false. |
| Exposure budget policy configured | **no** | CURRENT_EXPOSURE_BUDGET_POLICY is null. |
| Contract funding policy configured | **no** | CURRENT_CONTRACT_FUNDING_POLICY is null. |
| Contract life cycle covered (contractLifecycleReady) | **no** | Core keys still false: resourceAllocations, renewals, settlementAndReserveReconciliation. |
| Upload budget policy configured | yes | currentUploadBudgetPolicy(). |
| AI spend policy valid and every AI right funded (aiEntitlementsFunded) | **no** | Store ceiling $0.00 a month against $0.00 for every right at the largest request; Studio ceiling $3.36 a month against $747.90 for every right at the largest request; Scale ceiling $6.37 a month against $1,269.16 for every right at the largest request. |
| Every plan's AI ceiling at least the largest single request (lib/commercial-margin.ts, the upload/AI pool check) | **no** | Fails for Store (0 µUSD) against 2,266,342 µUSD. No customer count passes it; it needs a code decision. |
| Every LLC fixed-cost line has a reviewed ceiling | **no** | 24 of 24 lines are null; allocateEntireLlcFixedCosts returns null. |
| Funded exposure approved (assessFundedExposure) | **no** | Reason: unknown; 8 scopes (trial, setup, full_refund, non_payment, post_cancellation, paused, legacy_credits, platform_waitlist). |
| Minimum customer base sufficient (assessMinimumCustomerBase) | **no** | Status: unknown. |
| All required scenarios approved, including the overage ones | **no** | No review, so no scenario is approved. video_overage, visits_overage, orders_overage are still required. In CURRENT_COMMERCIAL_TERMS, traffic overage is "not-sold" and orders overage "not-sold"; the video overage price (3¢ an hour) is historical, never charged since 31 October 2026 (lib/watch-rules.ts). A scenario with no collected revenue is refused, so these cannot pass as overage revenue. |

## Unknown, never zero

- Every LLC fixed-cost line above (24 null), and every residual cost of the stored Hazelsong the LLC pays (FX275, HZ).
- Company costs the registry keeps out of plan lines (`NOT_A_COST`, 125 entries) and the account-move unknowns (`MOVE_COST_UNKNOWNS`, 6): not yet LLC fixed-cost lines.
- Stripe's tariff per API call and PayPal's per API call: no dated source in the registry.
- Human support: no cost line.
- Per-sale EU VAT/OSS (IV1) and UK VAT collection costs; Stripe Tax as a fixed fee per transaction.
- Funded exposure (trial, setup, full_refund, non_payment, post_cancellation, paused, legacy_credits, platform_waitlist): no review.
- The TX review per scenario (FX ceilings, annual books, incoming exchange operations): none exists before the LLC operates.
- Real invoices, the Vercel project's region, the Bunny Stream network and today's SES and Resend prices: not checked by this generator.
